Class CompiledRelation

java.lang.Object
gate.sql.condition.Relation
gate.sql.condition.CompiledRelation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Clause, CompiledRelationMethods, ConstantRelationMethods
public class CompiledRelation extends Relation implements ConstantRelationMethods, CompiledRelationMethods
A relation between two predicates of a compiled condition
